verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's marketing lists custom monitoring policies with instant alerts, plus automated recurring fixes and 'identify, notify, and fix' compliance drift. Together these suggest event-driven rules that trigger notifications and possibly fixes. The evidence is only thin pricing and homepage bullets; nothing documents a rule engine linking conditions to automated actions. missing for 10: documentation of user-definable event→action rules, explicit linkage of monitoring triggers to automated remediation or script execution, supported event types and action types, programmatic or AI-driven rule definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Reduce manual workload by automating recurring fixes.
